data.title: 爱宕 · 深夜卧榻的私密献身
data.description: 月光洒入的静谧卧室中，黑色薄纱睡袍完全滑落香肩。爱宕跪坐在床垫中央，黑色犬耳羞怯地伏在发间，金色眼眸含水微漾，主动牵引着你的双手抚上自己发烫的腰际。
data.location: dim moonlit bedroom with sheer curtains
data.action: sitting on bed with silk robe sliding completely off bare shoulders, dog ears lowered with sweet vulnerability, golden eyes glossy with arousal, guiding partner hands to her waist
data.lighting: pale silver moonlight highlighting soft curves and translucent fabric
data.mood: tender surrender, sacred vulnerability, irresistible temptation
data.promptProse: Sitting on the bed with her silk robe sliding off bare shoulders, Atago blushes heavily as she guides partner hands to her waist in the moonlight.
